description: Evaluation corpus for the /learn pipeline. Each group is one durable point said in different sessions and different words; a working naming pass gives every phrasing in a group the same label, and never shares a label between groups. `decoys` are pairs that look alike and mean different things, which is the failure mode a naive clusterer has. Point a real model's clusterer at this to measure it; the test uses a deterministic one to lock the pipeline's behaviour.

groups.label: use-bun-not-npm
phrasings: pnpm isn't what we use here

groups.label: never-force-push
phrasings: don't rewrite history that others have pulled

groups.label: discuss-before-implementing
phrasings: let's discuss this first, no code yet
talk it through before you touch anything

groups.label: stage-only-your-own-files
phrasings: only stage the files you changed
never git add -A, other agents are working here

decoys.label: doc-tools-off-by-default
phrasings: doc tools should be off by default
doc tools stay off unless asked for

decoys.label: network-tools-off-by-default
phrasings: network tools should be off by default
network tools stay off unless asked for

unverifiable: a directive the miner paraphrased into something nobody said
replayed: Open a release PR with bump type: **patch**. Identify ONLY the files you changed in this session and stage those.
